notes:
New
• Solo vids: choose which audio track is Discord (Track 2, Track 3, both, or none) under "Discord track" in the project. Next to each track, Solis shows what it detected.
• Premiere no longer freezes during long edits: the sequence is built closed and opens when the edit is done. Imports happen first; no saving in the middle of an edit; a busy Premiere is waited for.

Fixed
• Solo vids no longer keep the Discord call. Solis used to treat the track that talks the most as your mic, so when your friend talked more, it kept their talking and cut around it. Now track 1 is alway
• Pauses are measured on your mic alone after the call track is removed (before, the friend's talking still counted as "not a pause").
• Quiet small talk under −40 dB (mumbles, side comments, words with no voice behind them) no longer holds clips in the edit.
